bearing.model.v1alpha1.StateEntry.schema.description:
StateEntry is one entry of the resolver's own state: ordering keys,
 watermarks, sync progress and the like. It is primary state, backed up
 with the graph, and versioned by record time like everything else.

key.description:
The resolver's key. Any segment between "/" that is a ref ("new:<label>")
 is replaced by the subject the ref names, so a key can name a subject
 the same ChangeSet creates.

value.description: The value; absent deletes the entry.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.StateEntry.schema.title: State Entry
